text:
Type: white dandelion-style pendant lamp
Use: ambient and decorative light over a sitting area or a dining table; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, modern
Materials: white paper-like petals on slender stems, white plastic ceiling cup and cord
Colors: bright white, soft warm glow
Shape: large spherical globe of radiating star-like florets around a central bulb, hangs on a long cord, casts patterned shadows, big but airy and delicate
Feel: playful, airy, dreamy, soft
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pale textiles, green plants; Scandinavian or contemporary living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: IKEA PS MASKROS
product.description: Gives decorative patterns on the ceiling and on the wall.
